# AMS Civil Construction

> AMS Civil Construction is Mumbai's top-rated civil contractor with 25+ years of experience. We specialize in premium bungalow construction, bathroom & kitchen renovation, tiles, flooring, POP, plaster, waterproofing, swimming pool, compound wall, and full interior civil work across 90+ locations in India.

## Services Offered
- [Bungalow Construction](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/bungalow-construction): End-to-end luxury bungalow building — foundation to finishing
- [Bathroom Renovation](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/bathroom-renovation): Complete bathroom remodeling — tiles, fittings, plumbing, waterproofing
- [Kitchen Work](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/kitchen-work): Modular kitchen construction — countertops, cabinets, plumbing, electrical
- [Full Interior Work](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/full-interior-work): Complete interior civil construction — partition, ceiling, electrical, finishing
- [Tiles Work](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/tiles-work): Premium tile installation — wall tiles, floor tiles, vitrified, mosaic
- [Flooring Work](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/flooring-work): Italian marble, granite, vitrified tile, and wooden flooring
- [POP Work](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/pop-work): Designer POP false ceilings, cornices, and decorative moldings
- [Plaster Work](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/plaster-work): Internal & external plastering — sand-faced, gypsum, and cement plaster
- [Wall Work](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/wall-work): Brick masonry, block walls, partition walls, and retaining walls
- [Painting](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/painting): Interior & exterior painting — texture, emulsion, enamel, waterproof coats
- [Waterproofing](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/waterproofing): Terrace, bathroom, basement waterproofing — Dr. Fixit, Sika systems
- [Swimming Pool Work](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/swimming-pool-work): Private pool construction — excavation, RCC, waterproofing, filtration
- [Compound Wall Work](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/compound-wall-work): Boundary wall construction — foundation, RCC columns, brick masonry
- [Building Repair Work](https://www.amscivilwork.in/services/building-repair-work): Structural repair, crack treatment, concrete restoration

## Complete Renovation Packages

- **2BHK Complete Package**: ₹4.5L – ₹9L (35-50 days) — modular kitchen, 2 bathrooms, Italian marble, POP
- **3BHK Luxury Package**: ₹8L – ₹15L (45-70 days) — Italian marble, designer POP, premium kitchen, smart wiring
- **4BHK Ultra Premium**: ₹12L – ₹25L (60-90 days) — imported marble, Jaquar fittings, smart home, home theatre
- **Terrace Home**: ₹15L – ₹35L (3-6 months) — complete floor construction from scratch
- **Bungalow Turnkey**: ₹25L – ₹2Cr+ (6-14 months) — architecture to possession, everything included
